claim_boundary: Provider-free descriptive stratification of an existing 30-task, five-checkpoint F2P replay. Each checkpoint is an independently attempted bounded replay, so the rows describe checkpoint state composition and paired status agreement; they are not longitudinal survival, semantic, behavioral, adaptation, causal, or formal current-objective outcomes.
